title: Learning consequences degree
statement: Let $t>0$ be a rational influence bound and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter. The learning consequences degree is the ceiling of $t$ divided by the internal error associated with $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the internal error associated with $\varepsilon$, so its meaning cannot be made more explicit.
